notes: «يرفعه إلى» is the gap the text marks (rule 8): an unnamed link between Yunus and the Imam, in its place
«أبي عبد الله» is written inside the chain after «إلى», so it is a narrator link, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the Imam's «قال» introduces the Prophet's advice
«حدثنا أبي» opens with a bare kinship word: relation
